description: Official register data for one company in any country the site covers: name, status, legal form, dates, address, activity, and the page URL to cite.

country.description: fr = French (INSEE Sirene), gb = UK (Companies House), no = Norwegian (Brønnøysund Register Centre), ie = Irish (Companies Registration Office)

id.description: fr: 9-digit SIREN, or a 14-digit SIRET; gb: Company number, 8 characters (00445790, SC123456); no: Organisation number, 9 digits; ie: CRO company number, digits only

name: get_company
title: Company by register number, any country
